resources.name: Rb, Sr, H ultrasoft pseudopotentials (USPP from PSLibrary)

access.notes: Scalar-relativistic USPP by A. Dal Corso (PSLibrary version 0.3.1 or later). Needed for VCA construction.

Standard isotropic Migdal-Eliashberg gap equations can be solved with open-source codes (e.g., Elk, EPW) or a custom implementation. The agent must provide a solver that takes α²F(ω) and μ* and returns Tc.
